prose: A follow-up post on the GPT-6 Astra code-breaking story reports that the team is still analyzing the model's logs to see exactly how it executed the break. It also documents a July 2026 find in the German Bundesarchiv: several collections of radio messages, both enciphered and in cleartext, from the SS-Totenkopf Division's logistics command (Nachschubfuehrer).

Many of those messages were sent to the Ib (Quartiermeister) radio station and are identical to ones on the site's 1941 Message List; others are new but most likely related. The new messages are being added to the list in bold with an NF indicator - all NF messages are outgoing.
highlights: Researchers are still analyzing the GPT-6 Astra logs of the break.
July 2026: Bundesarchiv yielded new SS-Totenkopf logistics radio-message collections.
Many messages match the 1941 Message List; others are new but related.
New entries are marked bold with an NF (Nachschubfuehrer) indicator.
All NF messages are outgoing, sent to the Ib radio station.
